summary: Modern live-cell imaging of liquid-like condensates (BioImage Archive, incl. a hexanediol perturbation set) and volume EM of whole fixed cells (EMPIAR-10094, OpenOrganelle) exist, so foam-versus-filament geometry can be measured in both regimes, but no dataset pairs coagulating-fixative images with live images of the same cytoplasm and none records interfacial tension; the Cell Image Library could not be queried.
next_step: Define the modern referent (ER/condensate network vs cytoskeleton), then pre-register a junction-angle and topology comparison between live condensate movies (e.g. S-BIAD1666 before/after hexanediol) and a fixed-cell EM volume; the fixation-artefact half needs a new paired live/fixed image set.
obstacles_confirmed: Interfacial tension of the supposed fluids is not in the image metadata.
Historical fixatives are only partly matched by modern correlative datasets.
The historical structure may not map uniquely to a modern organelle.
